targets.authors: Weinberg, J., Nichols, S. and Stich, S.
targets.title: Normativity and Epistemic Intuitions
targets.evidence_quote: Abstract In “Normativity and Epistemic Intuitions” (NEI), Weinberg, Nichols and Stich famously argue from empirical data that East Asians and Westerners have different intuitions about Gettier-style cases. We attempted to replicate their study about the Gettier Car Case.
targets.outcome_quote: We found no evidence supporting the existence of cross-cultural difference about the intuition concerning the case.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract explicitly states the original cross-cultural difference and reports no supporting evidence in the replication.
